discovery_bias_transparency: MagLim 4/ell100,150,200 selected after examining published original LW07b lens-only n(z) support metadata; not blind with respect to n(z), but before new observed gamma_t residuals or nuisance fitting. No new observational detections are claimed.

target.probe: galaxy-galaxy lensing (lens galaxy positions x source tangential shear)
target.threshold_is_not: formal bound on GGL shear prediction, on ell bandpower window coverage, on signal-to-noise, or on forecast convergence

physical_formula.Weyl: W=(Phi+Psi)/2 from original Newtonian CLASS; require independent gauge-matter tracer dictionary
physical_formula.limber: k=(ell+0.5)/chi in 1/Mpc and chi comoving Mpc
physical_formula.thin_lens_GGL: C_ell^gkappa=ell*(ell+1)*integral dchi [ n_L(chi) b_L(chi) q_s(chi) / chi^3 ] P_{delta_gauge,W}((ell+0.5)/chi,z) in one chosen W and convergence sign convention
physical_formula.source_note: n_L is normalized per comoving length, not per redshift. The q_s geometry depends on background-source redshifts, but P_deltaW is evaluated only at lens chi where n_L is nonzero. Do not silently set uncovered n_L or source tails to zero.
physical_formula.derivative: At fixed FLRW background, fixed galaxy bias and source redshift kernels, dC/deta is the same weighted projection applied to physical dP_deltaW/deta; if tracer/bias responds to eta, include that response or marginalize appropriate nuisance.
physical_formula.observed_shape: gamma_t(theta) is a windowed Hankel J2 response of C_ell^gkappa plus IA, magnification and all published DES Y3 nuisance/systematic terms; the three native ell values are NOT a complete gamma_t window.
physical_formula.fisher: F_marg=t^T C^-1 t - t^T C^-1 D*(D^T C^-1 D+P_prior)^-1 D^T C^-1 t, t=physical dmu/deta, D=nuisance derivatives. A valid Asimov forecast also requires full observed-vector covariance and survey window.
physical_formula.sensitivity_output: Never produce sigma_eta/5sigma/percent from bare native lambda values, n(z)-mass fractions or missing covariance.

stop: Do not claim GGL viable merely because >99% of n_L probability mass lies in native support. This is candidate-only. Cosmic shear LW05 stop cannot be automatically transferred to GGL, but the specific GGL projection must still be certified. No posthoc cosmology/eta or selection tuning after seeing observed residuals.
